alternate_mechanisms.name: merciful_protection_of_perception
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Eye-gladdening favor and watchful care become an auditory protection in which harmful or worthless speech does not reach the rewarded persons; the basmala makes this selective protection an aspect of mercy rather than mere acoustic emptiness.

alternate_mechanisms.name: life_course_concealment_and_renewal
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Aging and burial supply decline and concealment, while fresh beginning and visible contented faces supply renewed manifestation 'that day.' This is an eschatological life-course underlay, not a narrated burial-resurrection sequence.

alternate_mechanisms.name: admission_to_a_guarded_interior
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The inverse possibility of being turned back sharpens repeated فِيهَا as admission; protective enclosure and inward privacy then define a communicative boundary through which vain or harmful speech does not pass.

alternate_mechanisms.name: faithful_agency_becomes_settled_reward
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Noble striving is specified as obedient and responsible action, understood and faithfully carried out; the result is then pictured as a trust safely deposited and made ready, extending satisfaction into settled reliability.

alternate_mechanisms.name: elevation_purifies_voice
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Place, rank, and furnishings are positively elevated, while elevated voice is filtered by moral quality: what is raised may honor and present, but clamorous or vain sound is excluded from hearing.

alternate_mechanisms.name: choice_goods_in_stable_arrangement
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Choiceness and noble place converge on cups assembled and set in stable order, making hospitality valuable, coherent, and usable rather than merely plentiful.

alternate_mechanisms.name: embodied_perception_of_inward_reward
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Face, eye, hearing-associated cognition, and hidden inward joy form an embodied perception path in which inner satisfaction becomes visible while the environment is experienced without corrupt auditory intrusion.

alternate_mechanisms.name: protected_household_intimacy
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The ranked marriage and kinship bridge can weakly organize enclosure, couches, cups, and purified speech as protected household intimacy. It is retained for recall and explicitly does not assert marriage or spouses in 88:7-14.
